effect.ZERO_FLUX_ALWAYS_ON: Allows the zero-flux speed boost to take effect regardless of flux level.
effect.SHIP_RECOVERY_CHANCE_BONUS: If disabled, this ship is almost always recoverable after the battle.

effect.PD_IGNORES_DECOY_FLARES: Point-defense weapons can identify and ignore decoy flares.
effect.PD_BEST_TARGET_LEADING: Point-defense weapons get the best possible target leading, regardless of combat readiness.
effect.PD_RECLASSIFY_SMALL_WEAPONS: All small non-missile, non-strike weapons are classified as point-defense, automatically target missiles, and are affected by point-defense stat modifiers.
stat.commandPointRecoveryWhileFlagship: command point recovery rate while this ship is the flagship
stat.fluxRateOfFireAndAmmoRegenWhilePhas: flux dissipation, weapon rate of fire, and ammo regeneration while phased
effect.PHASE_ANCHOR_EMERGENCY_DIVE: While at risk of being destroyed or disabled, this ship can instead perform an emergency dive into phase space, retreating from battle and suffering an additional combat readiness penalty equal to {value}% of its deployment cost. The ship must have enough combat readiness to cover this cost. Only one ship per battle, regardless of side, can perform this dive.
effect.BEAM_WEAPON_SPLIT_TARGETS_FLAT.on: Beam weapon hits split their damage evenly across the target and up to {value} additional nearby enemy. The target acquisition range is half the beam weapon's range. Split beams also carry the weapon's special beam effects.
effect.BEAM_WEAPON_SPLIT_TARGETS_FLAT.ot: Beam weapon hits split their damage evenly across the target and up to {value} additional nearby enemies. The target acquisition range is half the beam weapon's range. Split beams also carry the weapon's special beam effects.
effect.EXPLODE_ON_DEATH: When this ship is destroyed, it detonates violently, dealing high-explosive damage equal to up to {value}% of its maximum fuel capacity to nearby ships, tapering off with distance
effect.NON_BEAM_ENERGY_WEAPON_CHAIN_CHAN: Non-beam energy weapon hits that land on an enemy shield have a {value}% chance to chain to a nearby enemy ship. The chaining projectile has an equal chance to chain again, as long as it hits a shield.
effect.NON_BEAM_ENERGY_WEAPON_CHAIN_FALL: Each successive hit in a non-beam energy chain deals <bad>{value}%</bad> less damage than the one before it.
effect.ESCORT_MANEUVER_BONUS_PERCENT: While within range of a larger friendly ship, increases maneuverability (acceleration, deceleration, and turn rate) by up to {value}%, fading with distance. Doubled for a destroyer escorting a capital ship.
effect.ESCORT_SPEED_BONUS_PERCENT: While within range of a larger friendly ship, increases top speed by up to {value}%, fading with distance. Doubled for a destroyer escorting a capital ship.
effect.ESCORT_WEAPON_RANGE_BONUS_PERCENT: While within range of a larger friendly ship, increases ballistic and energy weapon range by up to {value}%, fading with distance. Doubled for a destroyer escorting a capital ship.
effect.ESCORT_PROXIMITY_RANGE_FLAT: The escort bonuses above apply at full strength within {value} su of the larger friendly ship, fading out over an additional 500 su beyond that.
effect.NANOFORGE_HULL_REGEN_PERCENT: After {seconds} seconds without taking hull damage, repairs {value}% of maximum hull per second in combat.
effect.DISINTEGRATION_ARMOR_DAMAGE_PERCE: Energy weapon hits on armor strip an additional {value}% of the hit's damage from the armor around the impact. This extra damage never reaches the hull.
effect.TERRIFYING_PRESENCE_ACCURACY_PENA: Enemy ships within {range} su have the target leading accuracy of their autofiring weapons reduced by <bad>{value}%</bad>.
effect.FIGHTER_BAYS_FLAT.warning: Cannot be unallocated without at least 1 empty fighter bay.
effect.FIGHTER_REPLACEMENT_RATE_MULT.slo: <bad>{value}%</bad> slower fighter replacement rate decay and recovery.
effect.FIGHTER_REPLACEMENT_RATE_MULT.fas: <good>{value}%</good> faster fighter replacement rate decay and recovery.
effect.BEAM_WEAPON_HARD_FLUX_PERCENT: Causes {value}% of beam weapon damage dealt to shields to be hard flux.
effect.SHIELD_DAMAGE_SHARED_PERCENT: Disperses {value}% of shield damage taken to nearby allied ships within {range} su, split evenly between them as hard flux.
effect.PHASE_FIELD_CONTRIBUTION_PERCENT: Even if this ship isn't a phase ship, {value}% of its sensor strength counts toward the fleet-wide detected-at range reduction that phase ships normally provide (see the Phase Field hull mod) - the more (and stronger-sensor) ships contribute, the less visible the fleet becomes, with diminishing returns. Only applies while the fleet's transponder is off.
effect.BALLISTIC_WEAPON_DAMAGE_PER_BURN_: Grants <good>{value}%</good> more ballistic weapon damage for every burn level this ship has above its hull's default, from any source.
effect.ENERGY_WEAPON_RANGE_PER_SENSOR_ST: Increases energy weapon range by <good>{value}</good> for every point of this ship's sensor strength (after modifiers).

effect.CREATE_FRONT_SHIELD_IF_NONE: Installs a makeshift, front-facing shield if this ship has none.
effect.CONVERT_SHIELD_TO_FRONT: Converts this ship's shield to front-facing.
effect.CONVERT_SHIELD_TO_OMNI: Converts this ship's shield to omni-directional.
effect.DEATH_ON_COLLISION: Any collision, however slight, is instantly fatal to this ship.
